top_rules: Maintain constant speed (steady walking, no sudden jerks)
Never step backward or hesitate mid-road
Look for an elder local or fruit vendor to shield walk
Wave or raise one hand low to signal intent
Beware of buses/trucks (motorbikes will dodge, big vehicles cannot)

xiaohongshu_rednote.search_term: 越南过马路 / 越南生存指南

top_insights.metaphor: 像溪水绕过石头 (Flowing water around a rock)
top_insights.description: 行人是溪流中的磐石，只要保持恒速匀速，摩托车流会自然如溪水般绕开。最忌讳犹豫不决、突然停步或向后倒退。

tactics: 眼神接触 (Eye contact with incoming riders)
紧跟本地阿婆/阿姨 (Follow local grandmothers across the street)
举手示意 (Raise hand towards traffic flow)
防坑交通：只坐 Grab 或 Vinasun/Mai Linh，绝不坐路边黑车
货币生存法则：去掉三个零除以三换算人民币，谨防多给零
